title: Happier Than Ever
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : FINNEAS/Billie Eilish
[00:01.000] 作曲 : FINNEAS/Billie Eilish
[00:02.000] 制作人 : FINNEAS
[00:03.000] 编曲 : FINNEAS
[00:05.038] When I'm away from you
[00:10.502] I'm happier than ever
[00:15.812] Wish I could explain it better
[00:21.305] I wish it wasn't true
[00:24.090]
[00:26.545] Give me a day or two
[00:31.614] To think of something clever
[00:37.216] To write myself a letter
[00:42.834] To tell me what to do
[00:45.646]
[00:53.890] Do you read my interviews?
[00:58.112] Or do you skip my avenue?
[01:02.843] When you said you were passing through
[01:07.894] Was I even on your way?
[01:10.758]
[01:12.264] I knew when I asked you to
[01:17.326] Be cool about what I was telling you
[01:21.591] You'd do the opposite of what you said you'd do
[01:26.372] And I'd end up more afraid
[01:28.907]
[01:31.290] Don't say it isn't fair
[01:33.649] You clearly weren't aware that you
[01:36.733] Made me miserable
[01:44.742] So if you really wanna know
[01:48.296]
[01:49.393] When I'm away from you
[01:54.946] I'm happier than ever
[02:00.144] Wish I could explain it better
[02:05.715] I wish it wasn't true
[02:08.665]
[02:28.236] You call me again, drunk in your Benz
[02:32.841] Driving home under the influence
[02:37.092] You scared me to death but I'm wasting my breath
[02:42.122] 'Cause you only listen to your f!cking friends
[02:44.065]
[02:45.429] I don't relate to you
[02:49.281] I don't relate to you, no
[02:53.281] 'Cause I'd never treat me this shitty
[02:57.170] You made me hate this city
[03:00.475]
[03:01.820] And I don't talk shit about you on the internet
[03:06.287] Never told anyone anything bad
[03:10.441] 'Cause that shit's embarrassing, you were my everything
[03:15.036] And all that you did was make me f!cking sad
[03:17.931]
[03:20.346] So don't waste the time I don't have
[03:24.814] And don't try to make me feel bad
[03:26.605]
[03:28.112] I could talk about every time that you showed up on time
[03:33.048] But I'd have an empty line 'cause you never did
[03:37.200] Never paid any mind to my mother or friends so I
[03:41.933] Shut 'em all out for you 'cause I was a kid
[03:44.795]
[03:47.552] You ruined everything good
[03:51.106] Always said you were misunderstood
[03:55.666] Made all my moments your own
[04:00.432] Just f!cking leave me alone
